mentions.name: logdot
mentions.description: This is a low-friction logging and metrics platform that provides easy visibility into apps, designed to be usable by anyone rather than geared towards enterprise.
mentions.problem: Existing logging and metrics tooling is geared towards enterprise rather than being accessible to individual users.
mentions.source_excerpt: I'm building a low friction logging/metrics platform that allows for easy visibility into your apps. The idea was to make something that isn't really geared towards enterprise and can be used by anyone.
mentions.author: lnenad
